text: EvidenceArchitecture is a multi-principal evidence architecture over principals and executions of the system under study: privateState is the evidence a principal actually holds in an execution, and emit is the declared interface projection producing what that principal exposes. Keeping PrivateField and EmittedView as distinct types, related only through emit, is what makes "the complete existing emitted interface is insufficient" a statement with content rather than a restatement of the definitions.
title: EvidenceArchitecture
